speaker: Ciro Schmeil
title: Consider Your Ways, and from This Day Will the Lord Bless You
summary: Elder Schmeil teaches that God gave two divine helps for the journey home: the Savior and our covenants, with the weekly sacrament keeping us on the path. His central story is the prophet Haggai: Israel worked hard but gained little, a 'bag with holes', until they made rebuilding the temple their priority, and God said 'from this day will I bless you'. He asks us to 'consider our ways', align our efforts with God, and make and keep covenants.

audience.who: All members, especially anyone tempted to skip church and the sacrament
